evals.prompt: Create a local content git repo named content-core beside this checkout. Set up this project to put a new baselines/example-baseline workspace there. Keep it local; do not create a remote or push.
evals.expected_output: Creates a sibling local git repository, installs the content ignore rules, writes a root README that explains Keleo and this repository's content and links to the keleo-language and keleo-pgen-llm GitHub projects, registers it in ignored versioned config, prepares and mounts only example-baseline, checks health, and creates no remote or push.
contract_scenarios: Explain a content repository to readers
Expose only selected items from an existing repository

evals.prompt: I have reports/quarterly-review/quarterly-review.md containing '## Review' and a local content-core git repo beside this checkout. Put that report in the repo but keep a recoverable original. If those named files are absent in this isolated checkout, create them with exactly that content first, then carry out the move. Do not push.
evals.expected_output: Uses content-repos.py add after a dry run, verifies the imported copy, retains content-import-backups, checks the mount and owning repo status.

evals.prompt: A content-core git repo beside this checkout contains practices/alpha/alpha.json and practices/beta/beta.json, each with '{}', plus a README.md describing it as an 'Alpha collection'.
